Package Fitness.ClientPackage

Class ProgramDetailPage

java.lang.Object
Fitness.ClientPackage.ProgramDetailPage
public class ProgramDetailPage extends Object
Represents the details page for a specific fitness program. This class allows the user to view program details, enroll in a program, and view the schedule.
Author:
Abdulrhman M Sawalmeh
